title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Client Engagement Administrator
description:
Full Time £26,000-£32,000

Newcastle

Onsite

This opportunity would suit someone with previous financial services experience and a strong customer service or administration background who enjoys speaking with clients and handling enquiries.

You do not necessarily need previous experience within financial advice. Experience gained elsewhere in financial services, including banking, could work well. What is particularly important is that you are confident on the phone, communicate well and are comfortable dealing directly with customers or clients.

If you enjoy keeping things organised, speaking with clients, liaising with providers and making sure clients receive an excellent service, this could be a very good opportunity.

This is a varied role where you will play an important part in supporting the delivery of the advice service. You will be involved in new business processing, keeping client records up to date, handling letters of authority, working with providers and third parties, and helping ensure Financial Planners have everything they need to support clients effectively. The role also involves maintaining accurate records, supporting pipeline progression, assisting with meeting preparation and helping deliver a high standard of service across the business.

The Business

This is a growing and ambitious financial planning and wealth management business with a strong focus on delivering high quality advice and an exceptional client experience.

The firm is investing heavily in technology, operational efficiency and the long term development of its people. It is building a modern advice business designed to make financial planning more accessible, efficient and valuable for clients, while also creating a supportive and progressive environment for staff.

This is an opportunity to join a business that is continuing to evolve, where administration is seen as a key part of delivering excellent outcomes for both clients and advisers.

The Role

Working as a Client Engagement Administrator, you will support Financial Planners, Personal Assistants and Paraplanners with the administration involved in delivering the advice service.

This is a broad and hands on role with plenty of communication with clients, providers and other third parties, so it would particularly suit someone who enjoys speaking with people rather than working solely in a back-office capacity.

Responsibilities will include taking ownership of the new business application process, processing new business within agreed service levels, working with providers and other third parties, handling letters of authority and transfer authorities, issuing documentation, maintaining accurate records on internal systems, assisting with pipeline updates and helping ensure planners are fully prepared for client meetings.

You will also deal with telephone queries, support the management of incoming and outgoing post when required, help resolve outstanding issues, and look for ways to improve processes and client outcomes.

Previous financial services experience is important, but this does not have to come from a financial advice business. Experience within banking or another financial-services environment could be a good fit, particularly if you are accustomed to dealing with customers, processes and providers.

You will need to be genuinely confident on the phone and comfortable speaking with clients and handling enquiries. A strong customer service or administration background, good organisational skills and clear communication will be important, alongside the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

Experience with industry systems or back office systems would be helpful, although training can be provided where needed.

The Benefits
- Salary of £26,000-£32,000 depending on experience
- Private Medical Insurance
- Medicash Health Cash Plan
- Pension plan with 5% employer contribution and minimum 3% employee contribution
- Group Income Protection at 75% of base salary
- Group Life Assurance at 4x base salary
- 28 days holiday, rising to 30 days after 2 years of service

Applying

To find out more about this opportunity, simply apply here.

One of our team will be in touch to talk you through the role in more detail and, if it feels like the right fit, we will support you through the interview process.

title: Receptionist / Administrator
description: Glenpark & Teams Medical Services is a busy general practice based in Teams and Dunston, Gateshead. We operate across two sites and offer primary care services to over 14,500 patients. This is an excellent opportunity to join our team of dynamic and forward-thinking receptionists and administrators based over both sites. Hours: Full time or part time considered Interview date: Thursday 8th October 2026 You will be the first point of contact for patients and will project a positive and friendly image to both patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone. You will receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective manner. You will also undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the practices. The successful candidate will be well organised, have good interpersonal skills and have the ability to work under pressure. The below list is not exhaustive but contains some of the main duties of the role: Greet patients and visitors to the practice and maintain a welcoming disposition at all times Answer general enquiries and explain surgery practice and procedures. Navigate patients to the most appropriate professional Register new NHS patients, and supply all new patients with the essential information about the practice. Receive and process requests for repeat prescriptions Record and pass on electronic messages to district Nurses, Health Visitors and other attached staff where appropriate Arrange follow-up appointments with doctors, nurses and other health professionals Answer all telephone calls in a courteous manner and deal with them appropriately Scanning/coding/processing documents and contacting patients as required. Full training will be given. Cross site working is essential.
